本报告检查26105全365场公司8的亚盘和大小球原始记录，不学习参数、不更新FM或票单。26105尚未全部结束，最终概率及收益比较待全期结算。实际采集时间晚于部分比赛，报价自身时间仅是历史诊断证据，不能冒充当时已观察到的数据。

```{r}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
library(testthat)
root <- normalizePath(params$project_root, mustWork=TRUE)
setwd(root);knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir=root)
inventory <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$inventory, simplifyVector=FALSE)
parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$parsed, simplifyVector=FALSE)
stopifnot(parsed$inventory_sha256 == digest::digest(file=params$inventory,algo='sha256'),
          inventory$scope == 365L, parsed$network_attempts == 0L,
          identical(parsed$historical_admission,FALSE))
fixtures <- map_dfr(inventory$fixtures, as_tibble) |>
  mutate(cutoff=lubridate::ymd_hms(cutoff_utc,tz='UTC'))
channels <- map_dfr(parsed$records, ~tibble(fixture_id=.x$fixture_id,kind=.x$kind,state=.x$state))
quotes <- map_dfr(parsed$records, function(record) {
  if(record$state != 'PARSED') return(tibble(fixture_id=character(),kind=character(),complete=logical(),phase=character(),quote_at=as.POSIXct(character(),tz='UTC')))
  map_dfr(record$snapshots, ~tibble(fixture_id=record$fixture_id,kind=record$kind,
    complete=.x$complete,phase=.x$phase,
    quote_at=lubridate::ymd_hms(.x$snapshot_ts_hkt,tz='UTC')))
})
expect_equal(nrow(fixtures),365L);expect_equal(nrow(channels),730L)
expect_equal(nrow(distinct(channels,fixture_id,kind)),730L)
expect_false(anyNA(fixtures$cutoff));expect_false(anyNA(quotes$quote_at))
quotes <- quotes |> left_join(select(fixtures,fixture_id,cutoff),by='fixture_id',relationship='many-to-one') |>
  mutate(eligible=complete & phase=='pregame' & quote_at<=cutoff & quote_at>=cutoff-48*3600)
counts <- quotes |> group_by(fixture_id,kind) |> summarise(snapshots=n(),eligible_quotes=sum(eligible),.groups='drop')
coverage <- channels |> left_join(counts,by=c('fixture_id','kind'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
  mutate(snapshots=replace_na(snapshots,0L),eligible_quotes=replace_na(eligible_quotes,0L))
expect_equal(sum(coverage$snapshots),nrow(quotes))
expect_true(all(coverage$eligible_quotes<=coverage$snapshots))
expect_true(all(quotes$quote_at[quotes$eligible]<=quotes$cutoff[quotes$eligible]))
```

365场名单与Titan分析页的主客身份均已校验；下表中的“截止内”要求完整赛前报价、报价时间不晚于开赛前24小时，且距该截止不超过48小时。该检查尚未执行跨来源赛程冲突裁决、价格合理性与联合市场DC拟合，因此不等于模型最终准入。

```{r}
summary <- coverage |> group_by(kind) |> summarise(channels=n(),
  parsed=sum(state=='PARSED'),missing=sum(state=='CACHE_MISS'),
  snapshots=sum(snapshots),channels_with_cutoff_quotes=sum(eligible_quotes>0),
  cutoff_quotes=sum(eligible_quotes),.groups='drop')
knitr::kable(summary)
knitr::kable(coverage |> count(kind,state))
```

原始数据由共享缓存API读取，身份清单与离线解析客户端均不发起HTTP请求；独立补采客户端使用已批准的5秒间隔与每渠道至多两轮重试。解析直接使用已安装后端的亚盘及大小球解析器，缺失原文、解析拒绝和空响应分别保留。缓存SHA变化会停止，而不会静默换入新版本。新增客户端测试覆盖导入无副作用、范围校验、主客身份不符、原文缺失、解析失败、SHA冲突及不可覆盖输出。

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(tibble(input=c('inventory','parsed'),sha256=c(digest::digest(file=params$inventory,algo='sha256'),digest::digest(file=params$parsed,algo='sha256'))))
```

复现顺序：运行 `src/global_dynamic_26105_channel_inventory_20261018.py`，再运行 `src/global_dynamic_26105_channel_parse_20261018.py`，为每次输出指定新的显式 `hot:` 位置；以上参数声明本次不可变输入。采集和模型分开，本次未修改package，也不代表整个goal完成。

本轮审查发现并修复：解析前逐渠道核对比赛／公司／市场路由；正文拒绝与普通解析拒绝隔离且保留原始提取收据；正文拒绝仍核验原文SHA；补采也隔离正文拒绝、保持完整性错误立即停止。旧补采进程因修复主动终止（退出−15），零个渠道结果，源文件及日志保留于过程目录；新版使用独立v2目录，最多两轮且不重置限速。并行网络采集曾触发共享锁超时，已改为来源顺序补采；已保存记录不重抓，限速时间与已记录重试次数不重置。软件检查与整期数据完成分别验收。

全期基础数据检查复用已有 `collect_issue` 和 `validate_tables`，不发布部分结果、不生成预测。R边界使用包内 `.SourceRows` 及后端声明的列类型，保留全空缺失值列与有类型的空表。新增回归直接执行客户端转换表达式，10个断言通过；包含历史元数据客户端的本地Python检查共17项通过。

```{r}
census_receipt <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(params$base_census,'receipt.json'))
expect_identical(census_receipt$target_labels_evaluated,FALSE)
expect_equal(census_receipt$receipt$expected_slots,365L)
expect_equal(census_receipt$receipt$network_attempts,0L)
expect_identical(census_receipt$client_sha256,digest::digest(file='r/global_dynamic_26105_base_census_20261018.R',algo='sha256'))
expect_length(census_receipt$outputs,2L)
# Receipt hashes follow the declared status.csv, resources.csv order.
for(name in c('status','resources')) expect_identical(unname(census_receipt$outputs[[match(name,c('status','resources'))]]),digest::digest(file=file.path(params$base_census,paste0(name,'.csv')),algo='sha256'))
base_status <- read_csv(file.path(params$base_census,'status.csv'),col_types=cols(issue=col_character(),slot=col_integer(),fixture_id=col_character(),state=col_character(),conflicts=col_integer(),gaps=col_integer(),missing_fields=col_integer(),error_type=col_character()))
base_resources <- read_csv(file.path(params$base_census,'resources.csv'),col_types=cols(.default=col_character()))
expect_equal(nrow(base_status),365L)
expect_setequal(base_status$fixture_id,fixtures$fixture_id)
history_metadata <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$history_metadata,simplifyVector=FALSE)
expect_equal(history_metadata$scope,365L)
expect_equal(history_metadata$network_attempts,0L)
expect_identical(history_metadata$inventory_sha256,digest::digest(file=params$inventory,algo='sha256'))
expect_identical(history_metadata$client_sha256,digest::digest(file='src/global_dynamic_26105_history_metadata_20261018.py',algo='sha256'))
metadata_status <- map_dfr(history_metadata$packets,~tibble(fixture_id=.x$fixture_id,state=.x$state))
metadata_support <- map_dfr(history_metadata$packets,~tibble(fixture_id=.x$fixture_id,
  competition_id=.x$result$target_competition_id %||% NA_character_,
  history_rows=length(.x$result$rows)))
expect_equal(nrow(metadata_status),365L)
expect_setequal(metadata_status$fixture_id,fixtures$fixture_id)
expect_equal(nrow(metadata_support),365L)
expect_false(anyDuplicated(metadata_support$fixture_id)>0L)
knitr::kable(count(base_status,state))
knitr::kable(count(base_resources,source,state))
knitr::kable(count(metadata_status,state))
knitr::kable(summarise(metadata_support,fixtures=n(),competition_present=sum(!is.na(competition_id)),history_rows=sum(history_rows)))
```

赛事与对手元数据只供后续同赛事样本匹配；尚未通过逐场截止准入、对手样本准备与原生λ估计。没有以26105目标赛果决定支持范围或模型参数。26106目录登记与本地赛程缓存检查均为空，只能记为本地未准备，不能据此断言线上不存在。

历史记录行数按目标比赛页面计数，同一场历史比赛可能出现于多个页面或不同历史区块，不代表互异比赛数；去重与截止准入仍由后续共享样本准备流程执行。

验收记录保存在 `docs/reviews/global-dynamic-26105-channels-20261018/`。本轮显式指定旧安装库的整套测试退出1：新增首次映射测试引用了旧安装包不存在的函数，分别产生1个错误和1个失败，该结果保留并拒绝计作通过。匹配安装库的并行独立整套运行已通过，日志也覆盖本轮新增的10断言；本轮核对相关源文件与测试哈希，并用匹配安装库重新执行原失败项及边界回归，共39断言通过。两安装库涉及本次采集与解析的7个Python模块字节相同，不改变既有采集绑定。没有提交其他会话的首次映射实现。

verification_dir <- 'docs/reviews/global-dynamic-26105-channels-20261018'
verification <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(verification_dir,'verification.json'))
verification$R_suites <- as_tibble(verification$R_suites)
verification$implementation_files <- as_tibble(verification$implementation_files)
expect_equal(nrow(verification$implementation_files),10L)
expect_identical(verification$status,'LOCAL_CHECKS_PASSED_GOAL_PENDING')
expect_equal(verification$full_R_exit_status,0L)
expect_equal(verification$full_python_exit_status,0L)
expect_equal(verification$own_python_exit_status,0L)
expect_equal(verification$runtime_resolution_exit_status,0L)

 verification$implementation_files$sha256[i],digest::digest(file=verification$implementation_files$path[i],algo='sha256'))
